title: Tight Space Lower Bound for Pseudo-Deterministic Approximate Counting
authors: Ofer Grossman (MIT, USA), Meghal Gupta (U.C. Berkeley, USA), Mark Sellke (Harvard University, USA)
abstract: We investigate one of the most basic problems in streaming algorithms: approximating the number of elements in the stream. Famously, [Mor78] gave a randomized algorithm achieving a constant-factor approximation error for streams of length at most N in space O(log logN). We investigate the pseudo-deterministic complexity of the problem and prove a tight Ω(logN) lower bound, thus resolving a problem of [GGMW20].
